name: Sensor Quality
description: Higher quality sensors can produce clearer images, reducing the analysis time. Poorer quality sensors might result in more ambiguous images requiring more time for analysis.

name: Image Resolution
description: Higher resolution images may require more time to analyze, but provide more detail. Lower resolution images are faster to process but may lack detail.

name: Weather Conditions
description: Poor weather conditions (e.g., rain, fog) can affect image clarity, making analysis more difficult and time-consuming. Clear weather might allow for quicker analysis.

name: Time of Day
description: Lighting conditions can vary significantly by time of day, affecting image quality. Brighter conditions can make images easier to analyze, while low light conditions can make them harder.

name: Camera Exposure Settings
description: Incorrect exposure settings can lead to under- or over-exposed images, which might need more time to analyze or require retaking the image.

name: Sensor Noise
description: Noise in the sensor can distort the image, making it harder to analyze. Lower noise images are easier to analyze.

name: Battery Life
description: If the UAV's battery is low, it might not have enough power to run the onboard classifier efficiently, leading to slower analysis or failed classifications.

name: UAV Speed
description: The speed at which the UAV travels between waypoints can affect the quality of the images. Faster speeds might lead to motion blur, making images harder to analyze.

name: UAV Altitude
description: The altitude at which the UAV is flying can affect the clarity of the images. Lower altitudes may provide better detail but can be more prone to obstructions.

name: UAV Performance
description: The overall performance of the UAV, including its computing power and hardware, can affect how quickly it can process and analyze images.

name: Distance to Waypoint
description: The distance to the next waypoint can affect the time it takes to take the image. Longer distances might mean the UAV is in motion for longer, potentially affecting image quality.

name: Operator Skill Level
description: The skill level of the human operator can affect the time it takes to analyze an image. Skilled operators might analyze images more quickly.

name: Human Factor
description: Human factors such as fatigue, distractions, or familiarity with the task can significantly affect the time it takes to analyze images.

name: Task Urgency
description: The urgency of the task might affect how quickly the UAV and human operator act. More urgent tasks might lead to faster analysis, while less urgent tasks might result in more thorough analysis.

name: Waypoint Complexity
description: Waypoints with more complex or diverse features might require more time to analyze. Simple waypoints might be easier to process.

name: Image Background
description: The background in the image can affect the analysis time. Simple backgrounds might be easier to analyze, while complex backgrounds might require more time.
